activities.title: Identify the product form
activities.body: Choose the statement that matches the product form.
activities.concept: Recognize when an expression is a product of two functions
choices: Two function factors are multiplied together.
A function is added to a constant.
A function is inside another function.
activities.correctAnswer: Two function factors are multiplied together.
activities.feedback: The product form means multiplication of two function factors. The other choices describe addition, a power, or composition.
